# Repository map

- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/config.py`: immutable validated TOML configuration.
- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/generator.py`: deterministic ticket-event simulation.
- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/analytics.py`: complete daily project metrics.
- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/forecasting.py`: leakage-safe rolling ridge forecasts.
- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/artifacts.py`: CSV and JSON output boundary.
- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/service.py`: application orchestration.
- `src/agile_ticket_simulator/cli.py`: thin command-line entry point.
- `config.example.toml`: documented runnable example.
- `tests/`: deterministic offline unit tests.
